## Implementation review: APPROVED

Artifact: branch worktree-knots-edf8-machine-id-atomic @ dc73d66916f2 (pushed), rebased onto f3244ad8.

Acceptance criteria, traced to code:
1. Concurrent first-use converges -- persist_first_use (src/machine.rs) writes a uniquely-named temp file then hard_links it onto the target. hard_link is the atomic create-if-absent primitive; on AlreadyExists link_or_converge reads the existing value and returns THAT, so a racer that loses still returns the id on disk rather than its own candidate. This is the criterion that matters: the old code let a lease be stamped with an id no later ownership check would resolve.
2. Persist failure surfaces -- machine_id returns io::Result<String>; the error is propagated, never discarded. All call sites updated, including src/sync/mod.rs, which knots-0f9c introduced after this branch was cut.
3. Platform split documented -- the module header states that deleting .knots/machine-id is recoverable where a system machine id exists (Linux) and permanent where it does not (macOS/Windows), and marks the recoverable-seed option as explicitly not implemented here.
4. Existing stores keep their id -- a non-blank existing file is always reused; only a blank file is replaced, bounded by a retry count.

Cross-knot safety, explicitly checked because this branch was cut before three other knots landed:
- The owner guard in recover_expired_bound_lease survived the rebase and still gates on ownership, not expiry. Its two regression tests pass.
- sync_publishes_before_it_takes_the_cache_lock still passes, so the cache-lock scoping is intact.
- knots-4bfa's PATH fix is preserved; grep for set_var("PATH") under src/ returns nothing.
- Conflicts in state_fail_ops.rs, replication.rs, tests_lease_owner.rs and machine_tests.rs were resolved toward main's semantics with this knot's fallible signature layered on.

Gates: make sanity exit 0 -- fmt, clippy -D warnings, size checks, 1294 tests, 95.24% coverage against a 95 threshold. Changeset .changeset/machine-id-atomic-first-use.md present. Pre-push hook re-ran sanity green on push.
